notes: Debug-only GPUv1-F02 implementation. solution/main.py implements doctor (exit 78 when inputs/deps missing, 0 when available, no training or inference), train (CUDA-mandatory 3-level U-Net, 16->3 with skip connections, per-channel train-set normalization, class-weighted cross-entropy, 12 epochs x 6 frames = 72 real gradient updates covering all six training fields, checkpoint with model/optimizer/step/normalization/class-weights/seed/python+numpy+torch+CUDA RNG state, predictions.npy (2,192,288) int 0..2, probabilities.npy (2,3,192,288) float32, run.json with synchronized timings and reload verification), and predict (reloads a checkpoint and runs new fields on CUDA). CUDA is required at runtime; no CPU fallback or mock weights are used. --help works without importing torch model code. This is the debug variant (frozen 6/2 stride-4 All-Hist subset with a small U-Net), not the reference-large DeepCAM protocol; no MLPerf-quality claim is made, and validation frames carry no labels so headline IoU is scored by the external oracle.
